reviews.text: Excellent service. Reasonable costs
Friendly staff who get you in on time and help you quickly

I’ve been bringing my fur children for a year now. Great experiences. Ask all of the questions you’d like without feeling pressured or overwhelmed. Doctors will explain with knowledge and patience. Dr. Gregory and Dr. Hardegree, thank you. GREAT location, reasonable prices.

The most amazingly loving professionals EVER!! Our dogs have been patients for years and even after moving over an hour away... We STILL unapologetically make the drive here for our pet care.  Thorough,patient, attentive and professional pet care at it's finest. 10 out of 10 for me

Took my boy Leche for shots let me say what great management also the employees went above any concerns and answers were there and leches shots nails and also meds for itching coat he's doin great enjoyment watching him run at parks n Beach thank you doctors and employees at kirkwood veterinarian great job
Had to take Woody in for a walk-in appointment and they treated him and us with such care! Great experience and more importantly, felt like we could trust them with our family!

Dr. Gregory and his team are truly the best. Everyone is so kind. I’ve been coming here for years. Whether it was helping my beloved frenchie with his angel birthday or helping us get ready to travel, they truly care. And it’s affordable!
Thank you Brandy for the pawsitive review! We appreciate you and your furbabies more than you know!
Good Vets and great staff.
Very personable vet, Dr. Gregory. I will continue coming here for my dog Ginger
They took very good care of my little baby! Great prices and very knowledgeable staff! Would definitely recommend to anyone in the area!

I took my Betsy in for her rabies and other shots.
The staff and the vet, Dr. Hardegree...were awesome and very patient with my 14 year old Chihuahua 💕 …

The BEST team in Houston! Everyone is so kind, welcoming, thorough and compassionate. I’ve recommended all of my family members to transfer their pet’s care here. They have been so accommodating on many instances and have taken such good care of our fur babies! It’s also much more affordable than a lot of other vets in the area. 100% recommend!
They helped our sweet family dog transition in the most compassionate and patient way possible. I would trust them with my fur babies in the future.
The staff here is amazing wouldn't take our fur baby's anywhere else

Excellent service and they love the dogs.
Also, when I rescue a dog, they always help me check its microchip. 🙏 …
LOVE THIS PLACE❤️It feels like family🧡They have ALWAYS showed Love and care for our Furbabies …

My experience at this veterinary clinic is fantastic. My dog ​​had surgery a month ago, and the care from day one was excellent. They're always attentive and keep you informed. The surgery went perfectly, and they did a fantastic job. Without a doubt, they give you the confidence and peace of mind to bring your furry friend here without any risk.

I made an appointment for a dental exam. Since it was my first time there, they told me to bring proof that my dog's vaccinations were up to date. I asked how much the service would cost for my dog, and they told me it would be $40. I made the appointment, and on the day of the appointment, the veterinarian and the assistants were very kind and friendly to my pet. At reception, when I went to pay, it turned out to be $54.00. I asked why, since when I called them, they told me the price was $40.00. The reason the woman, named Riley, gave me was that it was more because it was my dog's first time there. I explained that when I called, they never told me that; in fact, that's why they even asked me to bring his vaccination records, because it was his first time there. It bothers me when they tell you one price and then charge you more for the same service. It's not fair, and the vet only opened my dog's mouth and gave his teeth a very superficial check, like any dog ​​owner would do when they open their dog's mouth to look at their teeth. They didn't even take x-rays to get a better look at my dog's teeth. It's not worth paying for that service. Plus, the estimate they gave me just for a regular cleaning is $700 to $900 for a 16-pound dog—ugh, that's way too expensive!

I've been taking my several different pets here for over twenty years. The environment  has always been clean and welcoming. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable. We have always been treated with kindness and compassion. I'll always take my pets to this veterinary office.
My Tito has always been treated as part of Dr. Gregory and his team family!

I went in to this facility because I rescued a newborn kitten that needed to be bottle fed and they were so nice to me. I asked them if they had any syringes they could give me because I couldn’t find syringes anywhere and they gladly gave them to me the lady in the front office was a sweetheart. I haven’t been to the actual vet yet, but if it’s any indication the way this lady at the front desk is I would think they probably have an excellent veterinarian.
Thank you for the 5 stars! We truly appreciate your support!
Dr. Gregory is so compassionate . He treats each animal like his own and is incredibly intelligent
These people love animals. All you need to know.

Dr. Gregory is amazing, and has been our 2 dogs’ vet for a few years. The surgeon, Dr. Hardegree, was also great and friendly with our dog that needed surgeries. Both doctors explain things thoroughly and are patient with questions. The vet techs are helpful and knowledgable; The front desk girls are nice and responsive. 11/10 full team for your pets!!
Very friendly & knowledgeable.
They always take good care of my baby and vets are very friendly
Kirkwood always provides compassionate care for our animals.  20+ years with them.

Awesome vet, me and my cat were stressed out, I love the attention the vet paid to Mister, my cat, he checked him out thoroughly, he also told me that he was a beautiful and healthy cat and that he was more likely just stressing, I was able to relax a little after that and know that we are where we are supposed to be, he is just fine and back to being the mischievous cat he is. They don't say curiosity killed the cat for nothing! Thanks so much I am grateful to y'all for helping me to rest easier at a very difficult time in my life, thank you, and Mister thanks you as well!

5/5 stars. Dr. Gregory and the entire Kirkwood team provide truly exceptional care that goes above and beyond. They are incredibly responsive, attentive, authentic, and warm in every interaction. What sets them apart is their holistic yet practical approach to pet wellness, always putting our furry family members first while being wonderfully supportive of pet parents too. The level of genuine care and expertise makes them feel like guardian angels for our pets. While they refer out for imaging services, this focused approach allows them to excel at what they do best - providing extraordinary primary care and building meaningful relationships with pets and their families. They've absolutely earned their stellar reputation. If you're looking for thoughtful, compassionate primary veterinary care, look no further than Kirkwood.
Thank you so much for the positive review!
The staff was very friendly and helpful, and it's close to my house. I will definitely bring my pets here if anything occurs

Dr Gregory and his staff are FANTASTIC. They've taken good care of my four kitties over the years and thoroughly explain everything. They are never pushy and just give you all the information you need to make decisions about your animals care.
Amazing, compassionate group of folks. So kind to my elderly parents with their sweet elderly doggy.
